text: Last night, someone knocked.
I opened the door. Nobody.
Just an envelope. Inside, a photo of me.
Asleep. Taken last night.
On the back, four words.
Level nine needs you.
Then my old badge started to blink.
It has no battery.
So tonight, I'm going back.
I was a waiter. One dinner, one million dollars.
The only rule. Don't look up.
Seven guests. Seven masks.
And one empty chair.
I looked up.
Not one of them touched the food.
On the table, a list of names. Every name crossed out.
Except the last one. Mine.
The first mask turned to me.
Sit down, he said. That chair is yours.
I cleaned floors at Area fifty one.
One rule. Never open Room Four.
Every night, something tapped on that door. Three taps.
One night, I tapped back.
The window slid open. An old man looked out.
He had my face.
He held up a paper. Don't go home.
Then my phone rang. My wife.
She said, why are you calling? You just walked in.
